name: Daijuuji Kurou
source:
The protagonist of this work. A young man who once rode and fought on Demonbane, as the owner of the strongest Grimoire [Al Azif]. He is employed by the Hadou plutocracy as a magical detective, in order to deal with mysterious events [spoiler]in the newly reborn world[/spoiler]. This time, he sets out to investigate the [Blood Monster] cases that has been going around in Arkham City.

"It's true that if we just leave it as it is, i'm gonna have a bad aftertaste for sure."

[Translated from the [url=http://www.demonbane.com/special/]Demonbane Official Site[/url]]
